name: a2ui-renderer
title_zh: A2UI 界面渲染器，装上就能让 Agent 画表单
tagline_zh: 你的 Agent 开始返回 JSON 界面描述，但前端还停在纯文本聊天？这个 skill 让 A2UI 声明自动变。
tagline_en: Agent returns JSON UI specs but your frontend still shows plain text? This skill turns A2UI declarations into.
desc_en: Render A2UI (Agent-to-UI declarative surfaces) in CopilotKit v2. Enable the runtime via CopilotRuntime({ a2ui: {...} }), then enable the provider via <CopilotKit a2ui={{ theme }}>. Auto-activates via /info — do NOT manually pass renderActivityMessages. createA2UIMessageRenderer ships from @copilotkit/react-core/v2; low-level primitives (A2UIProvider, A2UIRenderer, createCatalog) ship from @copilot
why_zh: 它把渲染管线拆成两层：运行时负责激活，provider 负责主题，底层原语（Provider/Rend。
why_en: Splits rendering into runtime activation + themed provider, with low-level primitives (Provider/Renderer/catalog) fully exposed.
limit_zh: 只认 CopilotKit v2 的 A2UI 格式；非 A2UI 的 Agent 消息不会渲染。
limit_en: Only CopilotKit v2 A2UI format; non-A2UI messages won't render. Requires @copilotkit/react-core/v2 + runtime. Auto-activation via /info only—manual.
title_en: A2UI renderer that turns Agent output into tappable UI
